name: James European Tour — London Opener
notes: Opening date of James's two-month European tour spanning six major European cities (including London, Portugal, and Cyprus), following a prior run of US shows for expatriate Bangladeshi audiences. Illustrates the mature, multi-decade diaspora touring circuit sustaining Bangladeshi mainstream rock acts well past their 1990s domestic breakthrough era. Exact venue name not yet confirmed in available sources.
